card.name: Separators in tag and keyword lists
card.fires_on: Commas, bullets and 'under' that separate items in web page tag, keyword or category lists, often at the end of an article.

modes.label: Commas in tag lists
modes.description: The comma between lowercase tags or categories after 'Tags:' or 'Categories:'.

modes.label: Other list openers
modes.description: A bullet or the word 'under' or a keyword that starts or divides a topic list.
modes.example: filed<< under>>: Prohibition Need help with an
